thread:
elaine: quick check — proposal to denormalize route identity (route_name, product_tag) into console.telemetry_preagg to speed dashboard and quota joins. want to run this by infra + eng analytics before a spike test.

tariq: sounds useful. current hotspot is the route join on big queries, p99 blows up when route table is hot.

sam: can we avoid a big backfill? dualwrite + read-adapter seems safest.

lucy: agree. also need to ensure quota calculations don't accidentally double-count after denorm.

kevin: i'd like to see a contract matrix: what fields get denormed, nullability, cardinality, retention effects.

elaine: proposed fields: route_id, route_name, product_tag, org_tier. all SMALLVARCHAR or text, route_id stays as FK but we keep a copy for reads. nulls allowed for legacy rows.

maria: +1 on nulls. but we should add a source_version int on telemetry_preagg so we can detect if a row has denormed payload vs prebackfill.

elaine: good call. propose source_version enum: 0 = pre, 1 = dualwrite, 2 = backfilled.

tariq: migration plan sketch:
- phase 1: schema change add columns (nullable, default null), add source_version default 0
- phase 2: enable dualwrite in producer service behind flag (write both route table and telemetry copy)
- phase 3: shadow backfill job filling historical rows, mark source_version=2 when done
- phase 4: read-adapter route: prefer denorm fields if source_version > 0 else fallback join
- phase 5: remove join path after X weeks of monitoring

sam: add canary: enable dualwrite for 1% of traffic, validate parity with join results over a moving window.

lucy: we'll need a regression suite for quotas and dashboards. i can add ~20 prompt queries that represent heavy consoles (big tenants).

kevin: what about row size? telemetry_preagg is hot. adding 4 text columns could increase storage and IOPS.

elaine: we plan to compress route_name/product_tag via dictionary (varchar IDs) — PR will add route_name_id int references and keep human text optional. dualwrite will populate both id and text.

maria: also add a TTL policy for the human text to cut storage: keep text for 90d, ids remain forever.

infra-bot: perf note: adding columns triggers rewrite unless using "ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS" which is online for PG, but rewrite risk depends on default values. keep defaults null.

tariq: backfill approach: parallel workers by time shard, small transactions, measure replication lag. start with a dry-run estimate of IOPS and bytes.

sam: can we run the backfill in read-only mode first to compute expected size? i can write a sampling query (SELECT count(*), avg(length(route_name)) ...)

elaine: here's sample dualwrite snippet for service producers:
```
UPDATE telemetry_preagg SET route_id = $1, route_name_id = $2, source_version = GREATEST(source_version, 1) WHERE event_id = $3;
INSERT INTO telemetry_preagg (event_id, route_id, route_name_id, route_name_text, source_version) VALUES (...) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO UPDATE SET ...;
```

lucy: tests: parity job should compare metric outputs over 24h window. if deviation > 0.25% fail.

kevin: rollback plan? if parity fails, disable dualwrite flag and let backfill cancel. need schema backward-compatibility: reads must still join route table.

maria: monitoring: add dashboards for (1) dualwrite error rate, (2) backfill progress, (3) avg telemetry row size, (4) p99 dashboard query time. alert if p99 increases by 15%.

elaine: also add an API flag for customers to opt-in to denormed reads (for Dedicated customers wanting lower latency). default off.

tariq: permissions: private deployments might keep route text out of telemetry for PII concerns. add KMS tag to control whether text is written.

sam: ok next steps: sam + lucy to prototype parity job, tariq + infra to estimate backfill cost, kevin to prepare contract matrix, maria to draft dashboards + alerts. i'll open a PR for the schema change with migration hooks.

elaine: thanks. would like a sync tomorrow 10am to sign off on canary thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/telemetry-denorm-schema -> staging (CI passed). :rocket:

sam: i'll run the parity dry-run on staging after deploy. :eyes:

lucy: adding tests to the eval harness now.

kevin: added contract doc in the repo, link: https://git.internal/redwood/telemetry/denorm-contract

maria: will make dashboards in grafana and share links in thread when ready.

elaine: great, closing loop for now. cheers :thumbsup:
